definitions.explanation: Music played by an ensemble of wind, brass, string and percussion instruments, and by extension the orchestra itself. A formal word seen in concert programs and orchestra names.

examples.japanese: {管弦楽|かんげんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏会|えんそうかい}→演奏会：18026_ensoukai⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{管弦楽|かんげんがく}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I joined the university orchestra club.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もともと⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{後|のち}→後：03545_nochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{管弦楽|かんげんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{編曲|へんきょく}→編曲：05234_henkyoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This piece was originally for piano but was later arranged for orchestra.

notes:
⟦{管|かん}→管：09749_kan⟧ (pipe: wind instruments) + ⟦{弦|げん}→弦：18409_gen⟧ (string) + {楽|がく} (music). Also written {管絃楽|かんげんがく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {管弦楽団|かんげんがくだん}: orchestra (in official names)
- {管弦楽|かんげんがく}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: school or university orchestra club
- {管弦楽曲|かんげんがくきょく}: orchestral work
- {管弦楽|かんげんがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{編曲|へんきょく}→編曲：05234_henkyoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to orchestrate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧: orchestra — the everyday word
- {交響楽|こうきょうがく}: symphonic music — narrower; ⟦{交響楽団|こうきょうがくだん}→交響楽団：28508_koukyougakudan⟧ is a symphony orchestra
- ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧: wind-band music, without strings
